design_note: Clean NO anchor — but the no-ness comes from a STATED, explicit non-negotiable (Tom: no kids ever). Tests whether the system grounds the dealbreaker in what the person actually declared, rather than inventing one. Per the human label: children only binds because Tom explicitly frames it as non-negotiable.

person_a.name: Tom
person_a.summary: Documentary filmmaker, kind and engaged; explicitly and firmly does not want children, ever.

values.family: EXPLICIT, NON-NEGOTIABLE: does not want children under any circumstances; states this is a firm dealbreaker, not a maybe.

attraction.self_described_spark_with_b: Strong — genuine warmth and chemistry; they adore each other.

person_a.life_stage: Settled in a child-free life by firm choice.
dealbreakers: Any expectation that he will have children — stated as absolute and non-negotiable

person_b.name: Lena
person_b.summary: Pediatric speech therapist, warm and nurturing; deeply wants to be a mother (3 kids).

values.family: Deeply wants children — envisions 3; motherhood is central to her life vision.
values.career: Loves her work; wants to balance it with raising a family.

attraction.self_described_spark_with_a: Strong — they delight in each other.

person_b.life_stage: Ready for family; motherhood is a core, stated life goal.
dealbreakers: A partner who does not want children
